verdict.rationale: doola documents an official Embedded SDK that places its formation flow inside a partner's product, so a first-party SDK exists to build against. There is no evidence of language client libraries wrapping the Partner API, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec that could be used to generate SDKs. missing for 10: official language SDKs (e.g., Node/Python) for the Partner API, SDK reference docs/install instructions, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Embedded SDK puts doola's complete formation flow inside your product, in your branding, while you keep checkout.
